captions.text: RoutePulse: test a better campus transport plan with the fleet you already have. All campus data is synthetic.
A real optimization run: shift departures within published windows and reassign existing vehicles.
21 duty changes. All ten hard-constraint categories pass. The operator still decides whether to accept.
Same passengers and traffic: 706 → 849 completed journeys; 35.30 → 28.06 minutes mean wait.
Freeze this proposal. Test it on 20 prespecified synthetic days, with no retuning or selection of favorable days.
20/20 days improve completed journeys. Mean change: 149.8 journeys. Transfers worsen on 13/20 days.
Aggregate gains can hide harm. Inspect service and waiting time by passenger origin before making a decision.
Arrival predictions are evaluated against simulated ground truth. Reports expose measured errors and interval coverage.
Next: one campus shadow pilot with real historical data. This prototype demonstrates the workflow; field benefits remain unverified.
